label_definitions.C: Census document - any historical population, household, or estate enumeration, regardless of the specific name the archive uses for it: census, yard/household census, audit tale / revision list (reviz skazka), family list, lustration or estate inventory, or a conscription/military-service enrollment record. Usually organized around a place, estate, or named group of individuals for headcount, tax, or draft-administration purposes.
label_definitions.L: List of names or personal/identity cards for a defined institutional group - e.g. an organization's or office's employees, homeowners on a specific street or tax district, members of a named committee, or a professional group. Only for lists of PEOPLE. Does not apply if the list's real purpose is a general population/household census for a geographic area (use C instead) or passport application processing (use P instead), even if it is formatted as a list of names.
label_definitions.O: Other type of document. A document titled 'list of...' is not automatically L - if it lists places or things (streets, settlements, parks, routes) rather than named people, it is O instead.
